title: Arts & Crafts x Nature's Spirit
description: This mod adds integration features for Arts & Crafts and Nature's Spirit for a smooth gameplay experience!
body: ## About Arts & Crafts x Nature's Spirit is a mod that adds content to bridge the gaps between Arts & Crafts and Nature's Spirit so both mods can be played together flawlessly! **Requires Arts & Crafts, JinxedLib, Nature's Spirit and their dependencies** ## Features * The Chalk block set from Nature's Spirit is now called Calcite to avoid duplicate blocks! * The Chalk Powder item added by Nature's Spirit has been renamed to Calcite Powder for consistent naming * All saplings, plants and flowers added by Nature's Spirit can now be placed in Dyed Flower Pots added by Arts & Crafts ## Credits A massive thanks to Stellari for allowing me to remix the original Arts & Crafts logo for this mod!
